select t1.GCXMZJZJBID,t2.HTBH,t2.GCMC,t2.JSDW,t2.ESSCJE,t2.SGDW from TBL_YQNS_GCXMZJ_ZJB t1 inner join TBL_YQNS_GCXMZJ t2 on t1.GCXMZJID = t2.GCXMZJID where 1 = 1
and t2.HTBH like concat(concat('%',#{param.htbh}),'%')
and t1.GCXMZJZJBID = #{param.gcxmzjzjbid}
order by t1.GCXMZJZJBID DESC
